per_item_verification.item: 1 — the shipped TypeError at src/dashboard.ts:1722, and the guard's own concealment of it
per_item_verification.verdict: SPLIT — the TypeError is PASS, the order it was half of is FAIL
per_item_verification.typeerror_pass: Closed and verified in production, not read from the diff. `curl https://massar-engine.fly.dev/dashboard | grep Math.roundfmtN` → 0 hits; `grep 'fmtN(Math.round(target * eased))'` → 1 hit. Source reads `el.textContent = fmtN(Math.round(target * eased)) + rest;`. I loaded 17 routes at 3 viewports in a real browser with a pageerror listener attached: zero page errors, zero console errors. The two 404s my run recorded were MY OWN probe fetches to /admin/assets and /admin/winloss, which are not routes — I am not counting them against the build.
per_item_verification.concealment_pass: The blanker fix is correct and I falsified it. `blankFormatted` now refuses to blank when the character before `fmtN(` is [\w$.], so «Math.roundfmtN(» survives blanking. I re-injected the aed03a3 line verbatim into a sandbox copy: exit 1, «Math.roundfmtN does not exist — this throws at runtime». Reverting the round-19 idle-hours fix to a raw concat: exit 1. Clean tree: exit 0. All three controls reproduce.
per_item_verification.the_fail: countUp() IS STILL DEAD, and I proved it rather than inferring it. Static probe of all five elements countUp reads: raw «١ +١٠ تجريبية» → head «١» → replace(/[^\d]/g,'') → "" → parseInt → NaN → animates false. Same for «١٥» and three «٤». Live probe: I cleared _countedValues, called countUp() directly, and sampled document.querySelector('.kpi .v').textContent across 10 consecutive requestAnimationFrame ticks — all ten reads are «١ +١٠ تجريبية», changed:false. The animation has not run since 825a557 and does not run at e4facd0. My round-20 order M2 was explicit: «Then make a decision about countUp() rather than leaving it… Either revive it or delete the function and its call. Do not leave a dead animation with a live TypeError in it.» The TypeError half was done; the decision half was not attempted and is not mentioned in the commit message, in STATE, or in any of the 60 scenarios. SC-Y1 is marked PASS against the expectation «Then the animation works».
per_item_verification.a_trap_for_whoever_fixes_it: If countUp is revived by parsing «٠-٩» before parseInt, line 1735 `el.textContent = "0" + rest;` will paint a LATIN ZERO as the first frame of every KPI on #home. Fix that in the same edit or the revival ships a new numeral defect on the landing screen.

Your claim of zero UI-chrome Latin digits is TRUE and I confirmed it independently. Screenshots: .orbit/artifacts/regression/cpo21-kbproduct-sick-1440.png, cpo21-kbproduct-sick-375.png, cpo21-kbproduct-vacc-1440.png.
per_item_verification.and_the_whole_product: Since the route list should come from the router and not from me, I derived it from render()'s dispatch and audited all of it. #home 160/12 · #kmon 25/0 · #kmon/5 66/48 · #kmon/11 66/12 · #customers 2/185 · #aimkt 38/180 · #kb 13/3 · six #kb/<product> · #customer/966500000850 85/12 · #reports, #products, #pipeline 0/0. Identical at 1440, 768 and 375. I enumerated EVERY Latin run with its owning element: apart from the four on #kb/الإجازات المرضية, every single one is a Saudi phone number, the filename «lean-proposal-deck-v2.1.3-upload.zip», or the phone-format rule «أرقام 05 تتحول لـ966» where the Latin form IS the subject. That is the property, and this is the first round it is true of the product rather than of a list of screens.
per_item_verification.boundary_ruling: NOT a dodge, and NOT legitimate as drawn. I am separating those two judgements because they have different answers and both matter.
per_item_verification.why_not_a_dodge: Stating the exclusion in SC-Y3 instead of letting a green check imply completeness is exactly the discipline I promoted to Rule 7 last round, applied to the loop's own work within one round of being told. I credit it without qualification. Had these four numbers simply been left with no note, this envelope would read very differently.
per_item_verification.why_it_does_not_hold: Both premises are false and I traced them rather than arguing them. (a) «they come from PRODUCTS in agent.ts» — they do not. They come from PRODUCTS_FULL at src/dashboard.ts:291-297, a second hand-maintained array whose own comment says «mirrors src/agent.ts seed KB». dashboard.ts imports nothing from agent.ts. (b) «quoted VERBATIM to customers» — nothing is verbatim, at three separate hops. agent.ts:77 reads «الباقة القياسية (فرع واحد): 18,000 ر.س سنويًا · باقة المؤسسات (حتى 10 فروع): 95,000 ر.س سنويًا»; dashboard.ts:292 reads «القياسية 18,000 ر.س · المؤسسات 95,000 ر.س سنويًا»; and agent.ts:174 hands the string to the model as «التسعير المسموح ذكره: ${p.pricing}» — a permission, not a script. I read the four real transcripts in the live ledger that quote this price and every one is a different sentence: «لفرع واحد الباقة القياسية 18,000 ر.س سنويًا، وحتى 10 فروع 95,000 ر.س سنويًا», «للمجمع الواحد (فرع واحد)، الباقة القياسية 18,000 ر.س سنويًا», and so on. The portal is already desynced from what customers receive, in wording, by design. Converting four digits cannot desync what was never synced.
per_item_verification.and_the_evidence_cuts_the_other_way: The digits themselves ARE customer-facing — 18,000 and 95,000 appear four times each in the live ledger, so the substance of the concern is real and I want to say so. But the agent is already inconsistent with itself on exactly this: «٧٠٪» appears six times in the ledger (the campaign template openers) and «70%» five times (the model's conversational replies). Same claim, same product, both forms, both sent to real people. There is no single authored form to preserve. And the strongest datum is the customer's own reply, in his own ledger: «١٨ ألف مبلغ كبير علينا صراحة». The Saudi reader writes Arabic-Indic and the system answers Latin.
per_item_verification.so_what_should_happen: Not simply «convert them». Either (a) render them like every other number in the product, or (b) if the intent really is «show the operator what the assistant may quote», label the block «التسعير المسموح ذكره» and READ IT FROM agent.ts instead of keeping a second hand-typed copy. (b) is better because it closes a real drift hazard that (a) leaves open: two hand-maintained catalogues, which is precisely the class check-catalogue.mjs exists to guard, and this copy is unguarded. Severity `should`, not `must` — four runs of body copy, no display type, no adjacent contradiction.

grill.verdict: finding — the scope discipline finally worked, and the depth discipline did not
grill.evidence: Credit first, because it is earned and it is the thing I have been pushing for four rounds: round-20's third corollary said an audit's scope must come from the router, not from a human's memory. That landed. #kb/<product> was added to the changed_routes list, all four of its named defects were fixed, and my own router-derived sweep of 17 routes found the numeral property holding everywhere. The audited set finally grew. The failure moved axis again, and this time it moved DOWN rather than sideways: the fabricated CARD was deleted and the fabricated CONSTANT that fed it was left, still rendering on seven surfaces including the hero of the very page that was fixed. Rule 6, eighth occurrence, in its purest form yet — the leak is closed, the spill is one DOM node higher. The generalisation left to carry: when a fabricated VALUE is removed, `git grep` the value's SOURCE, not the string that displayed it.

grill.verdict: finding — one screen's information design is inverted; everything else is genuinely strong

Strong: #home in the aged state reads «٤ إجراء» over «٥٥ ساعة بلا متابعة» with a real next action per row and correct bidi. #kmon holds 8/8 cell alignment at every width with zero drift. The launch modal at 85 selected is one numeral system throughout. The placeholder routes are dignified rather than dead — #reports renders «هذه الوحدة ضمن المرحلة القادمة من «مسار» وفق خارطة الطريق — وحدة التسويق هي النشطة حاليًا»: named, honest, no dead button, no Latin. The new readiness card's grey-dot/green-dot + جاهز/ناقص grammar is clean and scannable. grill.verdict: finding — the right instinct, scoped one level too shallow, twice

But two shapes are wrong at the seam. grill.verdict: finding — the fix was executed well and the ORDER was executed partially, in the same way for the third round
grill.evidence: Craft credit, specific: the TypeError fix was verified in production rather than in the diff; the blanker fix is minimal and correct and its comment names the bug it conceals; the readiness card is better than the order I wrote. Craft failure, and it is one shape appearing three times: an order with an INSTANCE half and a MECHANISM half shipped the instance half. M2's instance (the TypeError) landed and its mechanism (decide countUp's fate) did not. M4's instances (nine counts) landed and the eleventh and twelfth did not. S1's instance-shaped parts were skipped entirely because the whole order was a mechanism order. Round-19 recorded this exact pattern as a process lesson for the orchestrator; it recurs at e4facd0. The craft standard is not «fix the line» — it is «run the surface, in the state that renders it, and close the order you were given or say why you are not closing it». SC-Y1 passing against «Then the animation works» is that gap made visible in the evidence file.

scores.rationale: intent_fidelity 8 (held). The intent is a room full of his own team seeing one deliberate Arabic-first tool. Measured by me over 17 router-derived routes at three viewports, the numeral property now holds on the PRODUCT rather than on a list of screens — every Latin run in the entire portal is a phone number, a filename or a phone-format rule, except four in one paragraph. That is the intent, achieved, and it is the first round I can write that sentence. It is not 9 because the demo's whole premise is that the numbers are real, and one screen shows six invented percentages with progress bars. completeness 7 (held, and again a net of movements in both directions rather than a clean 7). Up: the property holds portal-wide; the readiness card is computed and degrades honestly on all six services under genuine no-data conditions; fmtN 91 against 1 toLocaleString; the audited route set finally grew from the router. Down: two of five round-20 orders shipped partially (countUp undecided, the guard's message untouched), two import counts missed inside the very function the order named, and the deleted card's source constant left driving seven surfaces. coherence 6 (DOWN from 7, and this is the score that moves). One reason, stated precisely: the commit placed a truthful readiness number directly beneath an invented one and removed neither, so #kb/فحص الموظفين now says 74% and zero-of-four about the same thing on the same screen — and #kb gives its confident measurement bars to the six services with no knowledge while the two that have knowledge get none. Before this commit that screen was consistently wrong; it is now half-right and audibly self-contradictory. A product that argues with itself in front of the operator is less coherent than one that is quietly wrong, even though it is more correct. taste 8 (held). The screens are strong and the new card is well-written — absence copy that names the operational consequence is the round-17 sparse-explainer pattern applied to data, and I asked for a deletion and got something better. surprise 5 (up from 4). The card exceeded its order, and in doing so it exposed a real defect the fabricated card was hiding: campaigns carry free-text product names that never join to the catalogue, so «خدمات التطعيمات» reads «لم تُطلق حملة» beside «١ مكتسبة». An instrument that surfaces a problem nobody asked it about is the definition of the surprise point.

score_movement_ruling: I said in round 20 this would read 8/8/8/8/4 with M1-M4 and S1's honesty fix done. M1 is done and verified. M3 is done and verified under its trigger. M2 is half done. M4 is nine-elevenths done. S1 was not attempted. So completeness cannot rise to 8 on my own stated arithmetic, and I am not paying out on a bar I set myself. Coherence falls because a defect I did not have last round — an invented measurement sitting above a real one — got LOUDER as a direct result of the correct fix landing beside it. That is an honest and slightly unusual outcome and I want it named rather than smoothed: this commit made the product more correct and one screen less coherent, and both are true at once.

open_items_ruling.item: M2 split numeral systems — the four-round series
open_items_ruling.status: CLOSED as a screen-level property, for the first time
open_items_ruling.reason: Seventeen routes derived from the router, three viewports each, every Latin run enumerated and attributed. Two raw counts remain in one conditional import surface and four digits remain in one paragraph of seed copy; neither is a screen that reads as two numeral systems. I am closing the series and carrying the two residuals as ordinary change orders rather than as instances of it.

change_orders.order: Delete the invented knowledge scores — this is the demo-blocking one and the only thing in the product that states something untrue. src/dashboard.ts:299-306 hardcodes `sc: 92/74/71/55/55/63` on PRODUCTS; kbRegistry() at :1014 passes it through; :1041-1042 renders it as «٪ درجة معرفة المساعد» plus a coloured bar on all six #kb cards, and :1061 (`const ready = r.sc !== null ? r.sc : …`) renders it as the hero ring on every #kb/<product>. Live proof: #kb/فحص الموظفين reads «بانتظار ملف المعرفة | دون ملف تعريفي | ٧٤٪ جاهزية معرفة المساعد» in one hero line, with «جاهزية الخدمة ٠ من ٤ مكتملة» in the card below; #kb gives bars to the six services with no knowledge and none to the two that have it. Preferred fix: drop `sc` entirely and let the hero chips plus the new readiness card carry the state — they are already true. Acceptable fix: compute `ready` from the same four signals the new card uses, so the ring and the card agree by construction. Verify by loading #kb and all six #kb/<product> and confirming no percentage appears that cannot be traced to a query. This also closes round-20's S5 «معرفة» collision, because the collision only exists because two different things share the word.

Close the half of round-20 M2 that was not attempted: DECIDE countUp's fate. The TypeError is fixed and I verified it live — that half is done. The animation is still dead and I proved it two ways: every one of the five elements it reads yields parseInt('') → NaN → early return, and forcing countUp() then sampling textContent across ten consecutive requestAnimationFrame ticks shows no change at all. Either delete countUp() and its call at :1699, or revive it by mapping «٠-٩» to ASCII before parseInt — and if you revive it, fix line 1735 `el.textContent = "0" + rest;` in the same edit, because it paints a Latin zero as the first frame of every KPI on #home. Whichever you choose, prove it in a browser by sampling frames, not by reading the diff — no static tool in this repo can see this function. And correct SC-Y1, which is marked PASS against the expectation «Then the animation works».

Finish the import-result surface: src/dashboard.ts:1239 `'<span class="chip c-bad">تُخطّي ' + d.skippedCount` and :1244 `"صف " + s.row + ": "` are still raw, in the same function whose nine other counts were wrapped. This is the file-onboarding flow he asked for by name, and SC-A4 already documents «row 7 … skippedCount:2» reaching the portal summary while marking it PASS. Wrap both in fmtN and re-run SC-A4 with a malformed file so the scenario actually observes the rendered chip.

Make the guard's success line honest. It still prints «numerals consistent: every number in src/dashboard.ts routes through fmtN()» — a universal property claim that is false at this commit on six live sites in that very file (:292 «5 أيام», «↓70%», «18,000», «95,000»; :1239 skippedCount; :1244 s.row). I ordered this in round-20 S1(a) and named it in `what_would_make_this_ACCEPT`; it was not attempted. Change it to state the shapes it verifies — e.g. «no raw numeric expression is concatenated into UI text; no non-existent Math method» — and it becomes a keepable, honest regression lock in ninety seconds. This is a `must` this round rather than a `should` because it is the third consecutive round in which a claim the loop makes about itself is quoted upward as proof of a property nobody measured (user-model Rule 7).

Widen the guard past the line it was taught. My sandbox run: 21 realistic mutations, 3 caught, 18 passed — and all 3 caught are shapes a review round named. The Math-existence check is bolted to `Math.` while the failure CLASS is a mechanical sweep colliding any identifier with `fmtN(`: `escfmtN(x)`, `fmtNfmtN(x)` and `fmtNum(x)` all pass, and `const M = Math; M.roundd(x)` defeats the check in one line. Cheapest real widening, in order of value: (a) flag any call to an identifier that is not defined anywhere in the file and is not a known global — that catches the whole mangled-identifier class instead of one member; (b) add the ASCII-digit-inside-an-Arabic-string-literal rule with an allowlist for phone/version/CSS — three lines, and it catches :292 today; (c) make LATIN_PCT tag-agnostic (/%<\//) and extend it to a Latin % anywhere in an Arabic string literal; (d) re-scan the whole line rather than only re.exec's first match, so a UI concat after a CSS concat is not skipped.

Resolve the «18,000 · 95,000 · 70 · 5» boundary rather than restating it. Its premises do not hold: the strings are src/dashboard.ts:291-297 (a second hand-typed array, not agent.ts), and nothing is verbatim — agent.ts:174 hands the price to the model as «التسعير المسموح ذكره» and the four real transcripts each phrase it differently, while the agent already sends both «٧٠٪» (6×, template openers) and «70%» (5×, model replies) to real people, and the customer replies «١٨ ألف». Preferred fix, which is bigger than the numerals and worth more: import the catalogue from agent.ts instead of mirroring it, label the block «التسعير المسموح ذكره», and render the digits like every other number in the product. Minimum fix: convert the four runs. Either way, delete the second hand-maintained copy — it is exactly the drift class check-catalogue.mjs guards between agent.ts and insights.ts, and this copy is unguarded.

Join campaigns to the catalogue. The new readiness card surfaced this and it is real: campaigns carry free-text product names («سجل التطعيمات الوطني», 4 of 11) while insights.ts clamps every extracted interest TO SERVICE_CATALOGUE, so #kb/خدمات التطعيمات truthfully says «لم تُطلق حملة بهذه الخدمة بعد» directly above a scoreboard reading «صفقات مكتسبة ١ · قيد التفاوض ٣». Both statements are true and the join is missing. This is round-14's free-text-product-name finding, still open, now visible on a screen. Clamp the campaign's product to SERVICE_CATALOGUE at write time with an explicit «خدمة أخرى» bucket, same pattern insights.ts already uses.

Move the property assertion to where syntax cannot fool it — unchanged from round-20 S2 and still the mechanism that ends this series. Extend scripts/smoke.py to walk the rendered DOM of every branch of render()'s hash dispatch (including sub-routes, which is what would have added #kb/<product> before I had to) and fail on any ASCII digit outside an allowlisted node class. Extended once more — fail on any percentage whose value cannot be traced to a data query — it would also have caught this round's must. One runtime check, growing automatically as routes are added; the source guard stays as the fast pre-filter in front of it.

Carry-over, unattempted since round 19 and correctly deferred twice: the 375px header/row column drift on #kmon/5 (src/dashboard.ts:209, minmax(0, …) on the ≤900px grid-template-columns). Explicitly NOT before the demo. Schedule it with time to re-measure every other table the shared rule governs.

Two small ones. (a) «حكم السوق» sits inside a checklist headed «جاهزية الخدمة … مكتملة» — a market verdict accrues, it is not something an operator completes; either rename the card's counter or move that row out of the count. (b) The client script ships a comment block quoting the deleted card's fabricated strings to every browser; harmless, but «0 ملفات» and «2 من 8» are now greppable in production HTML and will confuse the next person who searches for them.

STATE.md is stale by five rounds — it reports engine @3725740, «Smoke guard 6/6 routes», and «Pending: CPO round-14 verdict on 9b7cd54», last written 2026-08-12T07:10Z. Bring it to e4facd0 with the round-21 verdict, or it will mislead the next cycle about what has already been closed.

Data hygiene, unchanged from rounds 19-20 and still visible: «clicnic» as a sector tile on #home's analytics, «القصيم» (a city) inside the SIZE facet on #aimkt, «صغير» duplicating «صغيرة», and the round-13 NVR artifact still surfacing in a next-action («مراجعة عرض الأسعار لباقات NVR لثمانية مواقع») on the aged #home queue.

user_model_updates.against: Rule 6, EIGHTH consecutive occurrence — rule holds; a new and final axis
user_model_updates.note: Round-20's third corollary (derive the audit's scope from the router, never from a human's memory) was HONOURED, and honoured well: #kb/<product> was added, all four of its named defects were fixed, and my own router-derived sweep of 17 routes found the numeral property holding portal-wide for the first time in eight rounds. The set finally grew. And the defect moved again — not sideways to an adjacent screen, and not to an unrendered state, but UP one DOM node on the screen that was just fixed. KB_SECTIONS was deleted; `PRODUCTS[].sc`, the constant that fed its «92%», was left, and still renders as «٩٢٪ درجة معرفة المساعد» on seven surfaces including the hero of the fixed page. Fourth corollary, and the one this shape has left: when a fabricated VALUE is removed, grep for the value's SOURCE, not for the string that displayed it. Deleting the render site is deleting the symptom.

user_model_updates.rule: Rule 7 — amendment to its stated DIRECTION. The rule stands: every number, count and property assertion the loop makes about itself must be bounded by what was measured. My round-20 wording added «the bias is consistently toward OVER-claiming completion, never under-claiming». That is now falsified: at e4facd0 `visual.note` says «16 comparisons» over an array of 18, an UNDER-claim. Drop the direction clause and keep the rule. Four-for-four across rounds 18-21, and what is constant is not the direction but the channel: the loop's PROSE about its evidence is not bounded by its evidence, while the evidence itself has been clean for two rounds running.
user_model_updates.evidence: round-18 «portal-wide numeral sweep» for six screens; round-19 «13 real non-zero ratios» when 12; round-20 «15 comparisons all non-zero» when one was 0.0, and check-numerals printing «every number… routes through fmtN()» falsely; round-21 «16 comparisons» when 18, and the SAME guard sentence still printing at a commit where six live sites in that file contradict it after being ordered corrected.

user_model_updates.note: My own error, recorded against the gate. Round-20's M1(b) read: «do not leave a hardcoded 92 beside a computed ring — either derive it from `ready` or delete the heading's number». I had it exactly backwards. `ready = r.sc` IS the hardcoded 92 (src/dashboard.ts:299, :1061); the ring was the fabrication and the heading was its duplicate. I named the fabrication as the fix SOURCE and pointed the builder at the symptom. The builder took the correct half — delete — and produced something better than I ordered, and the root survived because my order sent it the wrong way. Round-20's slop finding also called KB_SECTIONS «the round's ONLY correctness defect»; SC-Y2 quotes that phrase back, and it was not true. Procedural lesson for me, symmetric to the one I keep giving the builder: before ordering a fabricated number fixed, `git grep` the VALUE and enumerate every render site, or the order will close one of them.

user_model_updates.against: new — credit, recorded so the gate stays calibrated and not a complaint log
user_model_updates.note: Four things were done well and independently verified. (1) The numeral property holds PORTAL-WIDE for the first time — 17 router-derived routes × 3 viewports, every remaining Latin run a phone number, a filename or a phone-format rule, with four exceptions in a single paragraph. Eight rounds of instances finally became a property. (2) The replacement readiness card is better than the order I wrote: I said «delete it», and it was replaced with four real signals that degrade honestly — I broke it deliberately on five services with no KB doc, no asset and no campaigns and every one stated absence with its operational consequence. (3) The pixel bundle carries zero re-baselines for the second round running, all 18 ratios reproduce under my own recomputation, and the three by-construction zeros disclose themselves unprompted. (4) The exclusion in SC-Y3 was DECLARED rather than silently skipped — Rule 7's discipline applied to the loop's own work within one round of being told. Its premises are wrong and its instinct is right, and the instinct is the harder half to teach.

user_model_updates.against: round-19's orchestrator lesson, THIRD occurrence — promote to a process rule
user_model_updates.note: Round-19 recorded: «when a CPO order distinguishes an INSTANCE order from a MECHANISM order, the mechanism order cannot be silently deferred — it is the one that ends the series». It has now recurred three times. Round-19: fmtPct + delete-every-bare-toLocaleString deferred, and the next round produced M4 out of the untouched path. Round-20: the guard's honesty fix deferred. Round-21: M2's instance (the TypeError) shipped and its mechanism (decide countUp's fate) did not; M4's nine counts shipped and the tenth and eleventh did not; S1 was a pure mechanism order and was not attempted at all. Every partial delivery this round is the same cut — the instance half lands, the half that would prevent recurrence does not. Proposed process rule for the orchestrator, not the builder: a change order carrying both halves must be split into two tracked items at intake, so a partial delivery is visible as one closed and one open rather than as a closed order.

user_impact_summary_ar:
الخلاصة أولًا: المنتج في وضع أفضل بكثير من مراجعة الأمس، وأستطيع قول شيء لم أستطع قوله في ثماني جولات — نظام الأرقام موحّد في المنتج كلّه الآن، لا في قائمة شاشات. قِستُ سبعة عشر مسارًا استخرجتُها من مُوجِّه الصفحات نفسه لا من ذاكرتي، عند ثلاثة أحجام شاشة، وأحصيتُ كل رقم لاتيني متبقٍّ يدويًا: كلّها أرقام جوال، أو اسم ملف، أو قاعدة «أرقام 05 تتحول لـ966» — عدا أربعة أرقام في فقرة واحدة عن أسعار خدمة واحدة. والشاشة التي حجبتُ القبول بسببها أمس («معرفة الخدمة ← أي خدمة») كانت تقرأ رقمين عربيَّين مقابل ثمانية وثلاثين لاتينيًا؛ اليوم أكبر أرقامها بالعربية، والخمس خدمات الأخرى صفر لاتيني تمامًا.

وأهمّ ما أُصلح: البطاقة التي كانت تخترع أرقامها («جاهزية الأقسام — 92%»، أسعار مُلفّقة، «0 ملفات» تحت اسم ملفك المرفوع فعلًا) حُذفت، وحلّ محلّها بطاقة تُحسب من أربع إشارات حقيقية. جرّبتُ كسرها عمدًا على خمس خدمات بلا معرفة وبلا ملف وبلا حملات، فقالت الحقيقة في كل مرة، وشرحت الأثر التشغيلي لا الحالة فقط. هذا أفضل ممّا طلبتُه.

لكنّي لا أستطيع القبول بعد، لسبب واحد وهو بالضبط ما تقيس به المنتج: شاشة «معرفة الخدمة» ما زالت تعرض ستّ نسب «درجة معرفة المساعد» — ٩٢٪، ٧٤٪، ٧١٪، ٥٥٪، ٥٥٪، ٦٣٪ — بأشرطة تقدّم ملوّنة، وليس خلفها أي بيانات. وفي البطاقة نفسها، على بُعد ثلاثين بكسل، وسم يقول «لا معرفة بعد». والخدمتان الوحيدتان اللتان تملكان معرفة معتمدة فعليًا لا تُظهران أي نسبة إطلاقًا. أي أنّ الشاشة تمنح أرقام الثقة لِما لا بيانات له، وتترك ما له بيانات بلا رقم. هذا هو الرقم المخترع نفسه الذي حُذف من البطاقة — بقي مصدره، وما زال يظهر في سبعة مواضع. وهذا خطأ صحّة لا ذوق، وهو النقطة التي بنيتَ عليها المنتج كلّه: أن تكون الأرقام حقيقية.

التوصية عمليًا وبصراحة: احذف هذه النسب — لا تُصلحها. الوسوم الموجودة أصلًا («بانتظار ملف المعرفة» / «معرفة ✓» / «ملف تعريفي مرفق») تقول الحقيقة كاملة بدونها، والبطاقة الجديدة تحتها تقول الباقي. تعديلان مثبّتان، خمس عشرة دقيقة، ويزول آخر ما يقوله المنتج وهو غير صحيح. وإن لم يتّسع الوقت: اعرض كل شيء ما عدا «معرفة الخدمة» — بقيّة المنتج جاهزة، بما فيها الشاشة التي كانت ستنكسر أمس (قدّمتُ الساعة أربعين ساعة فقرأت «٥٥ ساعة بلا متابعة» بأرقام عربية، وصفر رقم لاتيني).

وثلاث ملاحظات أصغر: حركة تصاعد الأرقام على الشاشة الرئيسية ما زالت معطّلة — أثبتُّ ذلك بقياس عشر لقطات متتالية — والخطأ البرمجي الذي وجدتُه أمس أُصلح فعلًا وتحقّقتُ منه على الخادم المباشر، لكن القرار بشأن الحركة نفسها لم يُتّخذ. والفحص الآلي الجديد ما زال يطبع «كل رقم يمرّ عبر fmtN()» بينما ستة مواضع حيّة في الملف نفسه لا تفعل؛ جرّبتُ عليه واحدًا وعشرين عيبًا واقعيًا فأمسك ثلاثة. الفحص مفيد ويستحق البقاء — لكن الجملة التي يطبعها يجب أن تصف ما يفحصه فعلًا، وهذه ثالث جولة أطلبها.

لم تُرسَل أي رسالة واتساب إلى أي رقم في هذه المراجعة. كل الحالات وُلّدت داخل المتصفّح بتعديل البيانات في الذاكرة فقط، ولم يُكتب أي سجلّ على الخادم.
